_how: Weekly Record Recap on the stats page: only records and milestones from Allen's most recent game. The live copy is recap.json on the stats-data branch (publish there, no Netlify deploy); this copy on main is the fallback. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD of the game), game, result, allen (his line), official (true once checked against the official stats), items [{tag, scope (nfl, bills or blank), title, text, line}]. The section hides itself when items is empty or once a newer game starts. Win-chance chart (optional): wp {pts, p0, mu} copied from the jpa-live Worker after the game, with opp (abbr), oppNick, oppColor, home, bills, them.
allen: 11 of 21, 196 yards, 1 TD, 1 INT · 2 rushing TDs

items.title: Most total touchdowns in a player's first 10 seasons, at any position
items.text: He passed Peyton Manning (322) and has 325, in his 9th season.
items.line: 233 passing + 90 rushing + 2 receiving · 3 total TDs at the Jets

items.title: First QB with 11 rushing touchdowns through his team's first nine games
items.text: His 10th and 11th rushing TDs of 2026 passed Kyler Murray's 10 in 2020.

items.title: First QB with 5,000 career rushing yards and 90 career rushing touchdowns
items.text: His two TD runs made it 90. No other quarterback has more than 75 rushing TDs.

items.title: Games with a passing TD and a rushing TD
items.text: His own record is now 56 games (regular season). Next closest: Cam Newton, 45.
items.line: 45-yard TD pass plus two 1-yard TD runs

items.title: Games in which two teammates each ran for a touchdown
items.text: Allen and James Cook made it 17. Next closest: Dak Prescott and Ezekiel Elliott, 15.
items.line: Allen ran for two, Cook for a 74-yarder

items.title: NFL career rushing touchdowns: tied for No. 14
items.text: He tied Curtis Martin and Eric Dickerson with 90, among all players, not just quarterbacks.
items.line: One more ties Franco Harris and Jerome Bettis (91)

items.title: NFL career passing yards: up to No. 51
items.text: He passed Sonny Jurgensen (32,224) and now has 32,325.
items.line: Next up: Kurt Warner (32,344), 19 yards away
